title: Willie's cheap hats story
summary: Fragmentary anecdote about a man shooting off hats and Willie buying cheap ones.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: See the boy or something, at the wheelhead, the proprietor, the place. When Willie Dunnberg hit that door and they do that, shoot it off. And give him five hours and give him another the next day. So what Willie did, Willie just bought him a few cheap hats, you know? And when the man shoot it off, he'll give him five hours the next night. He put on one of them with a cheap one in his head.
